claim_boundary: The route-aware compact Q4/G64 gate/up-SwiGLU and down kernels compile and pass a native Metal non-contiguous-route oracle. This is a bounded reusable primitive; it is not a complete Flash body, source-independent NR, complete EBPW, capability result, resident TPS result, or promotion evidence.

implementation.route_contract: route_ids are source expert ids; route_lut maps source ids to compact slots; missing or out-of-range entries write deterministic zero

bank_contract.gate_up: [compact_expert, gate/up row, hidden] with gate rows followed by up rows

implementation.trace_registration: Both kernel names are admitted by Metal static trace naming and source-presence tests.

verification.native_test_result: passed; 1 test, 0 failed; two device dispatches
verification.static_kernel_name_test: cargo test -p hawking-core --lib static_kernel_name_tests -- --nocapture; passed; 30 tests, 0 failed
verification.diff_check: git diff --check on the three implementation files; passed

oracle_geometry.coverage: non-contiguous mapped routes plus an intentionally missing route

next_action: Integrate the compact Q4 banks into a bounded Flash resident path, preserving the existing BF16 control and measuring correctness, dispatch overhead, wall time, and bytes before considering a whole-body candidate.
